name: @apps/auth
description: Authentication service — human JWT, refresh, M2M token

scripts.build: bun run db:generate && bun build src/index.tsx --outdir dist --target bun
scripts.db:migrate: bun --env-file=.env scripts/ensure-db.ts && bun --env-file=.env x prisma migrate deploy --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push: bun --env-file=.env scripts/ensure-db.ts && bun --env-file=.env x prisma db push --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
